comment: Two inputs are declared and never given a port widget, GLOBAL_BP_IN and GLOBAL_BP_WIDTH_IN (TriDelay.cpp:91), so no click can reach them and they are left untagged. The menu's Delay Time items write the buffer length, but TriDelay.cpp:283 reads the panel switch and overwrites that value on the next sample, so only the switch has any lasting effect. Each tap's feedback is halved after the clamp (TriDelay.cpp:318), so the panel's 100 per cent is half the buffer level per tap.
